entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: Gluttonous 50-foot-tall swamp spirit that was once a frog, haunting Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Great Dominarian swamp haunted by Yargle.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Demon lord who turned his lieutenant Yar-Kul into a maggot.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: Belzenlok's ambitious lieutenant, turned into a maggot that a frog ate.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction whose Stronghold was attacked by the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that attacked the Cabal's Stronghold.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: Urborg elemental, daughter of Multani, who dragged Yargle back into the swamp and sought help for him.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-sorcerer who bound himself to Yargle to give resistance to glistening oil.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: Virulent Phyrexian substance dangerous to Yargle.

events.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot, which a frog eats and which later grows into Yargle.
events.quote: That maggot was eaten by a frog, which later grew into Yargle.

events.summary: Yargle defends the Stronghold when the Weatherlight attacks the Cabal and is dragged back into the swamp by Muldrotha.
events.quote: He was in turn dragged back into the swamp by Muldrotha .

events.summary: Yargle eats the charging Phyrexians, exposing himself to glistening oil.
events.quote: the more he ate, the more he exposed himself to the dangerously virulent glistening oil.

events.summary: Muldrotha pleads with her father; Multani binds himself to Yargle to grant resistance to the oil.
events.quote: Multani bound himself to Yargle, using his powers and existing knowledge of Phyrexia to grant increased resistance to glistening oil.

events.summary: After the invasion Multani and Muldrotha gain grudging respect for Yargle.
events.quote: Multani and Muldrotha gained a grudging respect for the bizarre monster

relations.quote: Muldrotha , an Urborg elemental who was the daughter of the maro-sorcerer Multani .
Belzenlok 's lieutenant Yar-Kul became too ambitious and was transformed into a maggot by the demon lord.
